scripts.setup: pnpm build && pnpm --dir playgrounds/nuxt exec nuxt prepare
scripts.dependencies:check: pnpm audit --audit-level high && pnpm audit signatures
scripts.packages:compatibility:built: pnpm -r --filter "./packages/**" exec publint --strict && npm_config_ignore_scripts=true pnpm -r --filter @verific/core --filter @verific/i18n --filter @verific/i18next --filter @verific/paraglide --filter @verific/vue-i18n exec attw --pack . --profile strict && npm_config_ignore_scripts=true pnpm --filter @verific/nuxt exec attw --pack . --profile esm-only
scripts.typecheck: pnpm build && pnpm packages:typecheck && pnpm --dir playgrounds/vue type-check && pnpm --dir playgrounds/nuxt exec nuxi typecheck
scripts.playgrounds:build: pnpm --dir playgrounds/vue build && pnpm --dir playgrounds/nuxt build
scripts.check: pnpm dependencies:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm packages:compatibility:built && pnpm test:coverage && pnpm playgrounds:build && pnpm docs:check:built && pnpm test:integration:built
scripts.release: bumpp package.json packages/core/package.json packages/i18n/package.json packages/i18next/package.json packages/paraglide/package.json packages/vue-i18n/package.json packages/nuxt/package.json
scripts.publish:ci: pnpm release:check --publish && pnpm check && pnpm -r --filter "./packages/**" publish --access public --no-git-checks
